records.title: Unauthorized state change through excessive agency
records.scenario: An agent, malicious context, or faulty orchestration causes an action outside verified user intent or the approved authority envelope, resulting in customer or institutional harm.

records.title: Identity or delegation failure
records.scenario: A stale, replayed, confused, or over-broad identity delegation is used to authorize an AI-enabled action for the wrong subject, purpose, resource, or time window.
